Study and mechanism: Gu et al. [109]: clothes-based adversarial loss (CAL)
Key assumption or resource: RGB images with identity and identity-specific clothing labels; collection dates can provide proxy clothing labels
Scope of reported evaluation: Retrieval on clothes-changing benchmarks; image and video settings
Integration question proposed in this re: Does identity continuity persist when clothing change coincides with occlusion, poor observations, or long absences?

Study and mechanism: Jiang and Ye [110]: IRRA (Implicit Relation Reasoning and Aligning)
Key assumption or resource: Paired images and descriptions with identity supervision; descriptions serve as retrieval queries
Scope of reported evaluation: Text-to-image retrieval on three public datasets
Integration question proposed in this re: How are ambiguous descriptions and queries without a matching gallery identity rejected?

Study and mechanism: Rami et al. [111]: online UDA (Unsupervised Domain Adaptation) setting
Key assumption or resource: Labeled source data remain accessible; target data arrive sequentially, and earlier target images become unavailable
Scope of reported evaluation: Online adaptation on Market-1501, Duke and MSMT17, with disjoint target identities across tasks in the reported protocol
Integration question proposed in this re: How do erroneous pseudo-labels affect subsequent identity registration and gallery maintenance?

Study and mechanism: Huang et al. [112]: CLUDA-ReID (Coordinated Lifelong Unsupervised Domain Adaptive Person Re-Identification)
Key assumption or resource: Sequential unlabeled target data and a limited memory of earlier examples
Scope of reported evaluation: Adaptation and forgetting under simulated stationary and dynamic target streams
Integration question proposed in this re: How do association errors interact with replay, model updates, and identity continuity?

Study and mechanism: Cui et al. [113]: continual compatible representation (C2R)
Key assumption or resource: Sequential identity-labeled training data; historical gallery features remain, but earlier raw images cannot be reused
Scope of reported evaluation: Re-indexing-free lifelong and lifelong Re-ID benchmarks
Integration question proposed in this re: How do compatibility updates interact with gallery growth, identity registration and retrieval cost?

Study and mechanism: Liao et al. [12]: open-set Re-ID protocol
Key assumption or resource: Queries may represent identities absent from the gallery
Scope of reported evaluation: Detection of gallery membership and identification of accepted queries
Integration question proposed in this re: Which rejected observations belong to the same new identity, and when should that identity be registered?
